name: c
notes: Root language of the software domain: the preprocessor-free ILP32 integer-C fragment SV-COMP's ReachSafety loop/bitvector tasks are written in — all integer widths through long long, one- and two-dimensional static arrays, goto, non-recursive helper functions (inlined), __VERIFIER_nondet_* as frame-addressed inputs, reach_error via __assert_fail as the bad observable; no pointers, floats, heap, structs, or recursion. Semantics is total and deterministic, chosen to be exactly mirrorable by a bit-vector transition system: two's-complement wrap everywhere, SMT-LIB division-by-zero rules (matching btor2), saturating out-of-range shifts, out-of-range array reads 0 / writes dropped. Execution is a machine over an elaborated CFG — each asgn/havoc/br node is one frame, exactly btor2's stimulus discipline ({"steps": [...]}, s_0 checked first, absorbing HALT/ERR) — so the c--btor2 pair keeps bad AND depth exactly. Validated beyond the vectors by differential testing against clang -O0 -fwrapv on the in-fragment SV-COMP corpus (random recorded-tape stimuli; see runs provenance) — 594 of the 598 in-fragment tasks interpret cleanly, the other 4 are dynamic VLAs refused loudly. Graded stipulated until corroborated by benchmark labels (the domain's anchors). Era-6 revision 1 = the Era-5 c text re-cut and re-admitted; the differential runs against clang are oracle testimony recorded as domain anchors (KERNEL.md §6). Revision 2 ships the first C-level certificate schema, `induction` (evidence/induction/check.py): k-induction, bit-invariants, and clause invariants stated over the elaborated machine's own atoms (pc bits, slot bits), discharged by a judge composed verbatim from the c front end, the c--btor2 machine encoding, and the btor2 judges' blaster, SAT solver, and obligations; the language's lineage now names those texts, because a proof certified here rests on them. The interpreter is byte-identical to revision 1.
